messages:
sara: FYI found an unexpected admin binding in the on-prem control plane. looks like a refactor introduced a broad role that ignores the VPC allowlist :warning:

matt: ugh. is this from the RBAC policy change last night? which binding exactly?

sara: yeah — PR #4123. snippet from audit logs:
```
2023-11-23T02:14:05Z user=svc-onprem-controller action=bind role=platform.admin scope=onprem controlplane_id=pc-09a3 binding_id=bnd-77
```
binding has `resource: "*"` instead of the expected `resource: "onprem/*"`

li: that `resource: "*"` would allow the service account to bypass the VPC allowlist checks at policy-eval time. checking KMS key policy now to see if keys were used. :eyes:

ops-bot: automated-detect: policy_change_detected (rule=r1003-rbac-broad-binding) user=sara detected_at=1776543225

jonah: if that SA had KMS decrypt perms we need to assume potential data access. li, pls confirm KMS logs for decrypts 02:00-03:00 UTC.

li: quick scan: no decrypt events for the onprem KMS key (projects/redwood-kms/keys/onprem-main) in that window. there are a couple of API calls from svc-onprem-controller but no Decrypt.

matt: still a privilege escalation vector. suggest immediate revocation of the binding and a hotfix to tighten the role. can someone revoke the binding and create a constrained binding with explicit resource list?

sara: revoking now. command I ran:
```
kubectl -n controlplane delete rolebinding bnd-77 --kubeconfig=/etc/redwood/onprem/kubeconfig
```
revoked at 1776543250. rolling back PR #4123 to a scoped variant.

neha: opened INC-2025-142 for tracking. severity=P2 for now, escalate if we find crypto access. assigned to eng-security + infra. https://redwood.atlassian/browse/INC-2025-142 :thumbsup:

jonah: good. also need to rotate any short-lived tokens that were issued to that SA in the last 24h. sara, can you list active tokens and revoke if present?

sara: listing: `rctl tokens list --subject svc-onprem-controller --since 24h` returns 3 tokens. revoking top two now.

li: KMS key policy note: onprem-main key had a legacy entry allowing serviceAccounts/* decrypt. I'm removing that and scoping to serviceAccounts/controlplane/* only. will push change to terraform in a follow-up PR.

matt: add an alert rule: if a rolebinding shows `resource: "*"` for controlplane roles, create a high/urgent alert. ops-bot can auto-revoke?

ops-bot: noted. can auto-revoke for bindings matching tag=onprem and resource=* with approval window=5m. need owner approval to enable.

neha: decision: enable auto-revoke for high-risk matches for 24h experiment. security oncall (matt) to monitor.

jonah: thanks. action items: 1) sara revoke and rotate tokens (done/ongoing), 2) li update KMS key policy + terraform PR (in progress), 3) matt add alert + enable auto-revoke (pending), 4) security to run full audit of controlplane bindings last 30 days (assigned to neha). ETA 24h for all.

sara: will post a short postmortem draft in #postmortems after we confirm no data access.

matt: add regression test to CI to catch wildcard resource bindings in controlplane RBAC.

li: noted. also adding an eval to the RBAC linter.

neha: closing loop — INC-2025-142 updated with mitigation steps and owners. marking interim status = contained. will re-open if KMS decrypts appear. :white_check_mark:
